numerical_measurements.native_type: float declared; split tab text in Perl may serialize as numeric string
numerical_measurements.meaning: Mash estimate of mutation distance from sampled k-mer Jaccard overlap; not alignment identity, coverage, ANI measurement or annotation probability.
numerical_measurements.formula: For j=x/s: D=0 when x=s; D=1 when x=0; otherwise min(1,-ln(2*j/(1+j))/k) in retained Mash source.
numerical_measurements.exact_inputs: Native counts x/s and k-mer length k from actual sketches; service returns distance/counts but not k.
numerical_measurements.population_denominator: Sampled union of two k-mer hash sketches, with denominator s actually output, not number of genomes or alignment bases.
numerical_measurements.uncertainty: No per-hit confidence interval returned. pvalue is a separate random-overlap statistic.
numerical_measurements.missing_behavior: Preserve missing/malformed as missing/invalid, never zero; do not recompute without actual k.

numerical_measurements.native_type: float declared; split text may serialize as numeric string
numerical_measurements.meaning: Probability under Mash random-sequence overlap null of at least x shared hashes. This is not function correctness probability.
numerical_measurements.formula: p=P[Binomial(s,j_r)>=x], j_r=r1*r2/(r1+r2-r1*r2), ri=li/(li+|alphabet|^k); retained source returns 1 for x=0.
numerical_measurements.exact_inputs: x,s, reference/query length estimates, k and alphabet/k-mer space; service returns only pvalue and counts.
numerical_measurements.population_denominator: The pair of compared sequence/sketch objects under random-overlap model; not a multiple-testing-adjusted database E-value.
numerical_measurements.uncertainty: Native p-value, not confidence interval; printed zero can reflect floating-point underflow/rounding.
numerical_measurements.missing_behavior: Unknown unless returned. Zero remains zero as reported, without claiming mathematically exact chance zero.

numerical_measurements.meaning: Shared hash count x and compared union-hash count s as emitted by mash dist. Preserve original string and each parsed integer.
numerical_measurements.formula: x=matching hashes seen while merging sorted sketches; s=union hashes considered, capped by configured sketch size; j=x/s if s>0.
numerical_measurements.exact_inputs: Native counts token; do not assume denominator 1000.
numerical_measurements.population_denominator: Sampled k-mer hash union, possibly fewer than nominal sketch size. Not read counts, base counts, genome count or query coverage.
numerical_measurements.uncertainty: Sketching gives an estimate; service does not return sketches or an interval.
numerical_measurements.missing_behavior: Reject malformed/noninteger/negative counts or x>s; denominator zero makes derived j undefined. Retain native row and error qualification.

numerical_measurements.native_type: number only when counts valid and denominator>0
numerical_measurements.meaning: Estimated sampled Jaccard similarity j, inspectable independently from Mash distance.
numerical_measurements.exact_inputs: Parsed native counts numerator and denominator.
numerical_measurements.population_denominator: s returned native compared union hashes.
numerical_measurements.uncertainty: No interval available without explicit sketch/statistical parameters.
numerical_measurements.missing_behavior: Unknown when counts absent/invalid or s=0; do not default.
